name: rnaseq.kegg
description: Perform offline KEGG pathway over-representation analysis using a selected gene list, user mapping and explicit eligible background.
use_when: Test over-representation of pathway memberships in a selected non-empty query against eligible RNA-seq background.
Use user-provided pathway mapping for any species with matching identifiers; gene list must be a subset of the declared background.
do_not_use_when: No declared universe/analysis_genes; using entire species annotation as an automatic RNA-seq background.
Raw counts, normalized expression or a ranked-list GSEA request.
Assuming human/mouse annotation or guessing transcript-to-gene ID conversions.

gene_to_pathway_mapping.description: Custom CSV/TSV/XLSX: gene_id,pathway_id; optional pathway_name. eggNOG: query/#query and KEGG_Pathway; KEGG_ko alone is insufficient.

enrichment.description: kegg_enrichment.csv: significant pathways with overlap, background/query size, pvalue, padj and contributing genes.

all_results.description: kegg_all_results.csv: full tested family including zero-overlap terms.

dotplot.description: kegg_dotplot.png: top enriched terms, or explanatory empty plot.

barplot.description: kegg_barplot.png: top enriched terms, or explanatory empty plot.

pathway_aliases.description: pathway_id_aliases.csv: ko/map reference-pathway alias conversions, not gene ID remapping.

summary_json.description: summary.json: SkillResult 2.0 including mapping/background sizes and methods.

r_packages.name: stats
r_packages.when: always; bundled with base R; fisher.test(alternative='greater') and p.adjust(method='BH')

python_packages.name: openpyxl>=3.1.5,<4
python_packages.when: XLSX mapping input only; installed as existing package dependency

requirements.filesystem: Readable local inputs and a new/empty writable output_dir; no network annotation lookup.

upstream.notes: Optional source: selected DEGs; external non-empty selected gene list also accepted.
Optional background source; excludes NA padj/log2FC. Exactly one background input.

limitations: Uses base-R Fisher exact test + BH, not clusterProfiler or an organism annotation package.
Effective background = declared eligible genes intersect supplied mapping; no automatic background fallback.
No mapped query is an error. Zero significant terms is succeeded with warnings and empty-result figures.
No automatic gene ID conversion: eggNOG query IDs must already match query/background, or use an explicit audited preprocessing crosswalk.
CSV/TSV and XLSX mappings supported, not binary legacy .xls; multiple XLSX sheets require mapping_sheet.
Significant means pvalue <= threshold AND padj <= threshold AND overlap > 0; tested family includes zero-overlap terms.
KEGG_Pathway memberships required; KO ortholog IDs alone are not pathway IDs.
koNNNNN/mapNNNNN reference pathways normalize to mapNNNNN; mixed reference/organism-specific namespaces are rejected.
Offline only; no KEGG REST lookup. Missing pathway names remain IDs; no fabricated labels.
